newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady late, commercial demand emerges.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady late, commercial demand emerges.

text.p: The Thai baht still moved in narrow range against the dollar in the onshore market with the emergence of some new commercial demand for dollars even at higher baht rates late on Friday, dealers said.
"The market was a little bit more active. There was some commercial demand for the dollar, while most interbank plyers remained sidelined," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht was traded at 28.50/29.00 per dollar near close in domestic market compared with 28.65/28.95 in early afternoon and 28.20/28.70 in the morning.
The Bank of Thailand announced the reference rate, which is the average of interbank trade from the previous day, of 28.189 per dollar compared with 27.383 on Thursday.
In the offshore market, the baht was quoted at 28.700/29.00 near the close against 28.70/29.00 in the morning.
Dealers said the market was still taking time to digest the new floating baht foreign exchange system, while the continuing two-tiered market also limited baht trading.
The baht/dollar one-month swap premium was traded at 30/40 satangs per dollar in the offshore market and 27/33 satangs onshore.
